t: This LAP linear LED cabinet light provides efficient and bright illumination for various indoor applications. It delivers 1250 lumens of cool white 4000K light from a 11W power consumption. Ideal for illuminating kitchen worktops, display cabinets, or utility room spaces, this surface-mounted light features an integrated LED with a 35,000-hour lifespan. The unit is linkable, allowing for extended lighting runs, and includes an on/off switch on the body for convenient control. Fixings and a corner connecting cable are supplied for straightforward installation.
b: L x W x H: 912mm x 24mm x 34mm
Linkable Design for Extended Lighting Runs
Integrated On/Off Switch for Easy Control
Surface-Mounted & Fixings Supplied for Quick Install
